entries.4cfb6d64064e71dd: This business develops and manufactures cosmetics, quasi-drugs, beauty supplementary products, cosmetic sundries and other goods and ships them to sales companies nationwide. Sales companies have sales offices and sales staff, and door-to-door sales to consumers are carried out by the sales companies. The company also conducts sales support activities for sales companies, but it has no capital or personnel ties with them. Products are manufactured at the Misato Plant in Misato Town, Kodama District, Saitama Prefecture, and research and development is conducted at the Development Research Laboratory. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,641 million; by product category, skincare was ¥1,899 million, beauty supplementary products ¥342 million, makeup ¥208 million, hair care ¥143 million, cosmetic sundries and other goods ¥29 million, and other cosmetics ¥18 million. As this is a single segment, there is no segment-by-segment disclosure.
